remarks: Welcome to Harbor Points Luxury Penthouse Collection. Elevate your experience to the Beacon lifestyle. This single story 2,204 sq ft. Penthouse offers breathtaking 180-degree views across the Long Island Sound. With this 3 bedroom unit enjoy spacious open concept, NYC views, Quartz countertops and terrific amenity accommodations such as, 24/7 health club, Yoga studio with on-demand classes, resort-style heated pool, fireside lounge, gas grill stations and more! Experience waterfront luxury living in the most coveted community of the fastest-growing city in Connecticut. Stamford's Harbor Point sits along the Long Island Sound with luxury marina access and views stretching to NYC. This thriving community features award-winning restaurants, nightlife, dock and dine access, acres of parks, boardwalks, retail, and 200+ curated community events a year. Floor Plan, amenity & fees sheet attached. Bldg runs credit/criminal on all applicants. The BR/LR picture is a stage mode.
